source.title: Szentes Város Integrált Városfejlesztési Stratégiája
source.retrieval: Web connector returned indexed PDF text (12777 lines) on first open. Subsequent direct open and PDF screenshot requests timed out; original PDF bytes and boundary image were not acquired.
source.documentAge: Municipal upload path is January 2015. This edition contains 2009/2010 material; cover/adoption date was not verified and must not be represented as a 2024 boundary definition.
locators: Belváros boundary list immediately following Figure 25
Indexed text lines 4337-4360 in first successful result
source.semanticUnit: The section explicitly defines named city quarters using functional, historical and development criteria, based on KSH and municipal data. Belváros is a whole named quarter in this partition, not a selected intervention area.

corroboration.title: 2015 ITS megalapozó vizsgálat
corroboration.locator: Printed pages 142-143, Belváros city-quarter definition; indexed text lines 6429-6441 and 8145-8147
corroboration.finding: The indexed text repeats the eastern/southern Belváros road/cadastral chain, including 4697 and 5631. First indexed read succeeded; later direct fetch timed out.

corroboration.title: Szentes Fenntartható Városfejlesztési Stratégia, modification dated 2024-06-27
corroboration.finding: Indexed visual descriptions identify colored outlined quarter maps labeled Kertváros, Felsőpárt, Nagyhegy, Iparterület, Belváros, Alsópárt, Kisér. No map pixels/coordinates were acquired; later PDF screenshots timed out. Names and apparent partition persist; exact geometric equivalence to the older circuit is not established.

corroboration.title: Municipal non-transferable property annex
corroboration.finding: Property 4697 is listed as public space at Attila út; property 5631 is a public road at Szent Anna utca. The source ties cadastral identifiers to names but does not identify centerline geometry.
corroboration.sourceAge: Web index says approximately seven months old at this review; legal annex adoption/version date was not established.

corroboration.title: 2018 municipal asset regulation proposal
corroboration.finding: 4697 is a public road at Attila út; 5631 is a public road listed as unnamed in 2018. The later annex name is not sufficient evidence for silently selecting a particular current OSM continuation.

actualRoadAlternatives: Apponyi tér to Baross uses an approximately 150.65 m segment of Deák Ferenc utca.
Attila to Koszta uses an approximately 151.92 m segment currently named Nagyvölgy sor.
Szilfa to Vásárhelyi uses an approximately 70.36 m segment currently named Lajos tér.
unresolved: Apponyi tér refers to a square; its sole OSM-named street does not by itself determine the intended perimeter traversal. A shortest road connection cannot establish the source boundary.
Property 4697 has a documentary Attila label but the direct connecting present OSM road is named Nagyvölgy sor. Parcel-to-OSM identity remains unverified.

Unnamed OSM way 68081874 extends Szent Anna toward the river, reducing the remaining nearest-centerline gap to 42.65 m, but cadastral identity and the exact river crossing/shore convention remain unverified.
Arany ends at Ifjúsági sétány, about 37.54 m from the OSM Kurca centerline. The text does not specify a shoreline-versus-centerline convention.
actualRoadGraphAudit.reason: First strict named-feature audit retained its gaps; later bounded reconstruction in raw/szentes-bounded-inference-proof.json tests actual existing OSM road/path alternatives and exports one explicitly estimated review candidate.

rights: Street/river names and factual boundary descriptions are recorded as facts. No municipal map geometry or bulk PDF is redistributed. Any independently reconstructed road-centerline candidate must retain OSM ODbL attribution, inferred status, source-era limits and no address-assignment approval.
